start: A member's page, signed in as owner, gym online; the member was measured once last month

steps.action: Scroll to 'Body measurements'
user_sees: The last entries, newest day first, who measured, and '+ Add'
The line 'Members see these in their MettleUp app (Progress → Body) after they check in at the gym once.'
must_not: Another member's entries
'+ Add' shown while offline

steps.action: Tap '+ Add'
user_sees: A sheet 'Add measurements' with today's date, Body weight (kg), Body fat (%), nine tape sizes in cm (Waist, Chest, Arm, Hips, Thigh, Neck, Shoulders, Forearm, Calf) and a note
must_not: A future date as the start value

steps.action: Type 72,5 for weight and 84 for waist, save
user_sees: 'Measurements saved. <name> sees them in the MettleUp app.'
The new entry shows '72.5 kg' with the change since last time (for example −1.5) and '84 cm'
must_not: 72,5 refused or saved as 725
A change shown against the wrong earlier entry
Two entries for one tap

start: The Add measurements sheet, signed in as owner

steps.action: Save with every box empty
user_sees: 'Type at least one measurement.'
must_not: An empty entry saved

steps.action: Type 500 for weight, 1 for body fat, 400 for waist
user_sees: 'Body weight: a number from 20 to 350 kg.', 'Body fat: a number from 2 to 75 %.', 'Waist: a number from 5 to 300 cm.' each at its box
must_not: Only the first problem shown
A value outside the range saved

steps.action: Pick tomorrow as the day
user_sees: 'The day can’t be in the future.'
must_not: A future entry saved

steps.action: Save a second entry on a day that already has one
user_sees: 'This member already has measurements on that day. Edit that entry instead.'
must_not: Two entries on one day
The old entry overwritten without a word

steps.action: Type a note of more than 200 letters
user_sees: 'Note: up to 200 letters.'
must_not: The note cut without a word

start: A member's page with a saved entry, signed in as owner

steps.action: Open the entry
user_sees: A sheet 'Fix measurements' with the saved values
must_not: Empty boxes for saved values

steps.action: Change the weight and save
user_sees: 'Measurements updated.'; the change figures of this and the next entry follow
must_not: A second entry instead of a changed one

steps.action: Tap delete
user_sees: 'Delete these measurements?' with 'Delete'; then 'Deleting…' and 'Measurements deleted.'
must_not: Deleted with one tap and no question
Another day deleted

steps.action: Open an entry that someone else deleted a moment ago and save
user_sees: 'That entry was deleted on another device. Close this and look again.'
must_not: The deleted entry comes back
A raw code such as NOT_FOUND

steps.action: The member was removed from the list meanwhile; save
user_sees: 'This member is not on your gym’s list any more.'
must_not: The entry saved for a member who is gone

start: A member's page, signed in as owner; then the member's own phone

steps.action: Save an entry with a note for the desk
user_sees: The note shows in the panel only
must_not: The note sent to the member

steps.action: The member opens MettleUp, Progress, Body (after one check-in at the gym)
user_sees: The same numbers, marked as from the gym by its name
must_not: Another member's numbers
The numbers shown before the member ever checked in at this gym
The gym's entry overwriting the member's own entry of that day without a mark

steps.action: As front desk (not a trainer) open the same member
user_sees: The card is there for the desk too (this card has no role check of its own; the server decides)
must_not: Body numbers of a member shown to a person the gym did not mean
